questions.question: The class spends R300 on ingredients and sells 120 vetkoek at R5 each. Find the income and the profit.
questions.expected_answer: The income is 120 times R5, which is R600. The profit is the income minus the costs: R600 minus R300 is R300.

questions.question: How much flour is three quarters of a 2 kg bag, in grams?
questions.expected_answer: 2 kg is 2 000 g. One quarter of 2 000 g is 500 g, so three quarters is 3 times 500 g, which is 1 500 g.

questions.question: 3 tarts are shared equally among 4 helpers. How much does each helper get, and how do you know?
questions.expected_answer: Each helper gets three quarters of a tart. Cut each tart into quarters to get 12 quarters, and 12 quarters shared among 4 helpers is 3 quarters each.
